name: Rod-Airfoil / Fan Broadband Noise Benchmark
description: Measures the accuracy of broadband noise prediction methods using canonical fan and rod-airfoil benchmark cases.
evaluation_method: RMSE / spectral error (difference in predicted vs. measured Sound Pressure Level spectra); correlation of spectral shapes
general_score_metric: RMSE of predicted SPL spectrum (or SPL difference in dB across frequency bands)
reputation: Niche, domain-specific benchmark known within the aeroacoustics community for validating broadband fan and rod–airfoil noise prediction methods.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark requiring CFD/aeroacoustic simulation or high-fidelity measurement inputs; small set of canonical cases; metrics and evaluation protocols vary across studies; low contamination risk from text corpora.
